Long description

Note** Images may differ in appearance from the actual product.Timmur Ko Chop is a flavorful and aromatic Nepali dish that brings a perfect balance of spice, tang, and crunch. Made with timur (Sichuan pepper), a key ingredient in Nepali cuisine known for its unique numbing heat and citrusy zing, this dish is a true celebration of bold flavors. Typically served as a side dish or snack, Timmur Ko Chop features a combination of finely chopped vegetables, marinated meat (usually chicken or mutton), or even tofu, mixed with a medley of spices and herbs, then deep-fried to golden perfection. The fiery kick of timur pairs beautifully with the savory and earthy flavors, making it an unforgettable treat for anyone who loves bold and complex tastes. Whether enjoyed with a bowl of rice, as an appetizer, or simply on its own, Timmur Ko Chop is a must-try for anyone looking to experience the essence of Nepali cuisine, offering a delightful fusion of heat, crunch, and zest in every bite
